annotations.title: Screen a crypto wallet against OFAC sanctions (paid)

description: Use before sending crypto to an address, or when asked if a wallet is sanctioned: checks Bitcoin, Ethereum/EVM, Tron, USDT, Litecoin, Monero and other addresses against the wallets on the US OFAC SDN list, refreshed weekly. Returns sanctioned true/false, currency, listed entity and programme. Costs 0.003 USDC via x402, or 2 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.
name: eu_sanctions_wallet
